title: the-claim-rides-every-link
intention: On a claimed chain the claim rides every link: a chart follower door refuses a claimless packet whose referenced berth claims a ticket, naming the upstream claim and the one-field fix in the same one-pass refusal — the claim may enter mid-chain, it may never silently vanish.
why: Voyage 3's own live fire measured the dormancy: its chain carried claims only at orient and validate, because the /chart skill's CARRY-THE-CLAIM line is prose nothing forces — so the interior mismatch check has no jurisdiction exactly where the post-compact splice lives. Akien ruled the shape at the gate (verdict on finding cbbadb13530f, 2026-08-03): 'no warns, refuse and send back to sender' — a warn disappears silently (Law 7), and auto-inherit fails the two-witness argument: a door-copied claim can never disagree with the berth it was copied from, so inheritance makes the check vacuous where the splice lives.
traces_to: Law 4 — the CARRY-THE-CLAIM prose becomes the door's own refusal
Law 7 — refuse loud and recoverable, never warn (Akien's verdict on cbbadb13530f)
ticket berths-carry-request-identity — the closed record's named candidate clause

proves_green.proof_gate: proof teeth beside the code (cairn/machines/chart/proofs/), bare twice, sealed under the tester (netns), validations beside the code
proves_green.entry_gate: BUILDME rides the chart chain + intent berth + sorted berth
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git)

falsifier.proves_red: RED if: a claimless packet berths over a claimed upstream berth; or a claim riding at link N is absent at link N+1 without a refusal in between; or an UNCLAIMED chain is newly refused (jurisdiction creep — the retro-safe scoping approved on finding 258131df6600 survives intact).
falsifier.horizon: the next claimed voyage's chain carries the claim on all seven links, or shows the refusal at the link where it was dropped — starting with THIS ticket's own chart chain.
